entries.784119e7741c1f7c: Its strength is its in-house variety-breeding capability. Based on the Hashie Research Institute in Isesaki City (a research facility for biotechnology, floriculture and hydroponic cultivation) and especially the Sada Breeding Farm, it has its own technologies, including producing miniature tubers using biotechnology. Beyond seeds and seedlings, its strength also lies in its overall capacity to support agricultural production, from sales of agrochemicals, coated fertilizers and agricultural materials, to design and construction of hydroponic cultivation plants and greenhouses, and cultivation technical guidance. Local subsidiaries in the Philippines and Thailand handle contract production of seeds and part of overseas sales.

entries.af966b1cbba78879: Its reportable segments are four: the Seed and Seedling Business, the Floriculture Business, the Agricultural Materials Business and the Facility Materials Business. In the fiscal year ended May 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥34,550 million for the Agricultural Materials Business (about half of the total), ¥15,264 million for the Facility Materials Business, ¥9,573 million for the Seed and Seedling Business and ¥8,345 million for the Floriculture Business; the Agricultural Materials Business, centered on agrochemicals, was the largest. Information by region is omitted because revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue. No specific customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.e3bf6acdbea21963: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥67,733 million, up 5.0% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. By segment, the Agricultural Materials Business was ¥34,550 million, the Facility Materials Business ¥15,264 million, the Seed and Seedling Business ¥9,573 million and the Floriculture Business ¥8,345 million.
entries.e42371f7f9ac6079: It adopts “Daidō ni Ikiru Keiei” as its creed and, under the basic management policy of “High-Tech and Internationalization,” works on research and development of new products and technologies and on nationwide and overseas expansion of both seed production and sales. As the second year of its medium-term management plan, it is further advancing research and development and building a new sales structure to strengthen global expansion. In Japan, it aims to contribute to stable food production by developing varieties with high yield, pest and disease resistance and high germination, and to improve producers' profitability through varieties that save labor and add value. For feed, which it relies heavily on imports for, it will also develop high-quality forage seed domestically. It will also work to realize a sustainable society and sustainable agriculture, including reducing greenhouse gas emissions and promoting resource recycling.
entries.f48324154ffe264a: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,325 million, up 10.4% from ¥1,200 million in the previous consolidated fiscal year.
entries.f4c7808cd68af9e7: Centered on in-house developed varieties with resistance to pests and diseases, high yield and good taste, it produces and sells vegetable seeds, forage seeds, virus-free seedlings and seed potatoes. In addition to selling agrochemicals, coated fertilizers and agricultural materials, it also designs and constructs hydroponic cultivation plants and greenhouses.
